target_customer: Attorneys, court reporters and transcribers handling depositions and trials
problem: Court reporting and deposition transcription are slow and costly, which limits access to justice and burdens litigation teams.
business_model: Software subscription for attorneys, court reporters and transcribers, including a desktop product for court reporters
product_category: Legal AI for depositions and court reporting

founders.name: Adnan Sherif
founders.background_notes: YC page says he was an ML engineer at Google on generative AI for Pixel and earlier an ML researcher at Berkeley's Sky Lab.

founders.name: Yash Ramchandani
founders.background_notes: YC page says product manager at Google on Pixel AI features and ads, and earlier roles at the startups Kalshi and Relay.

competitors.name: Parrot
competitors.what: AI transcription platform for depositions and court reporting

competitors.name: Skribe.ai
competitors.what: AI court reporting startup with a Zoom based deposition product

technical_complexity.rationale: Legal specific speech models and real time assistance are well within AI startup reach, with accuracy requirements for legal records being the hard part.

defensibility.rationale: Several funded rivals sold similar AI transcription, and distribution through court reporters is the main differentiator.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Rev acquired the AI deposition summary product SmartDepo and Steno raised a $49M Series C in March 2026. No Draft The Record acquisition was found.

market_need_then: Court reporter shortages and high transcript costs created demand, and speech models improved by 2024.

branding.domain_note: Uses drafttherecord.com as an exact match for the CamelCase name. History not found.

identity.visual_style: Not observed because the company site returned HTTP 429
identity.voice_and_tone: Mission language about faster and affordable access to the justice system

brand_strength.rationale: No brand press was found and the name is a legal phrase that is easily confused with generic drafting terms.

outcome_analysis: Draft The Record is a five person YC S24 company serving attorneys, court reporters and transcribers. Its founders came from Google's Pixel AI teams, but no verified funding, press or exit was found. Its YC page also mixes in an unrelated ADHD product called Focus Buddy, which may signal a split in focus that sources do not explain.
notes: Company website returned HTTP 429, so it was not read. YC page lists founding year 2025 but the batch is Summer 2024, so 2024 is used. Standout lists $500K seed and Dealroom a $125K seed with no investors; both are aggregators and unverified. An Altss entry for Sterling Labs, Inc. mentions DraftTheRecord Desktop, which may be a legal entity name, unconfirmed. Completeness pass: the 125K seed rests on a single database, Dealroom, with no date or investors. The 500K Standout seed seen earlier appears to belong to a different company, AI For Litigation, so it is not recorded.
